headline: Jamaica's Six-Month Government Revenue Misses Budget Target by $175 Million
summary: Jamaica's fiscal revenue and grants fell J$27.8 billion ($175 million) short of budget estimates between April and September 2026 due to lower tax collections.
why: Tax revenue performance is central to Jamaica's fiscal rule compliance and debt service stability.

impacts.name: Jamaica
impacts.why: A $175 million budget shortfall pressures Jamaican government spending plans.
